body: Original logo-free 2994 salvage vehicle game sprite sheet, transparent PNG, landscape 7:4, EXACTLY eight complete separated views in 4 columns 2 rows. Inspired by 1999 US Isuzu VehiCROSS 3door compact SUV: SHORT wheelbase tall rounded futuristic coupe-like SUV with two side doors, very short rear side window, chunky matte black molded cladding over ENTIRE lower half with ribbed door sides, oval headlamp pods with round lamps, narrow rounded black grille, broad black hood insert, swollen rear tailgate with integrated covered spare-wheel bulge, short roof and steep rear window. Weathered silver metallic upper body with subtle rusty seams, faded red repair stripe on both lower doors, black cladding. Stock proportions, no lift or roof luggage, no concept convertible. No badges text logos numbers. All wheels and tires ABSENT, transparent wheel arches for separately animated runtime wheels. No ground shadows. Row1: FRONT straight; FRONT LEFT threequarter noseRIGHT; LEFT PROFILE noseRIGHT; REAR LEFT threequarter noseRIGHT. Row2: REAR straight; REAR RIGHT threequarter noseLEFT; RIGHT PROFILE noseLEFT; FRONT RIGHT threequarter noseLEFT. Generous gutters, each full vehicle fits its cell without touching neighbors. Same vehicle eight distinct orientations. Detailed painterly photoreal game artwork.
dashboard: Original badge-free2994 salvage cockpit overlay transparent PNG ultrawide3:1. Driver-eye straight-ahead LEFT-hand-drive1999 Isuzu VehiCROSS inspired dashboard, no seats. Dark charcoal rounded padded dash with sculpted hooded instrument binnacle on LEFT, leave its broad black recess completely EMPTY for runtime live instruments. Narrow vertical air outlet at far left. Tall slightly driver-angled center stack just right of middle: plain cassette radio at TOP, two large horizontal rectangular air vents BELOW radio, then small horizontal climate-control panel below vents, then dark open storage cubby. Smooth passenger airbag panel and glovebox on right. Red leather trim at lower corners and narrow pillars, subtle scuffed charcoal plastic and tiny repaired copper seams. NO steering wheel, clear dark mounting area on LEFT for shared animated wheel. NO printed instruments numbers text badges or emblems. Entire upper windshield area transparent, narrow red/charcoal pillars at edges, dashboard lower half. No exterior road or scenery, no ground. Vehicle-specific restrained photoreal painterly game art.
